think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented meaning in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/force) rather than just scaling behavior. 3) Verify whether such sentinel values are explicitly documented as having special semantics distinct from the normal numeric ordering. 4) If no such sentinel values exist and the knob always behaves as a continuous cost parameter, classify it as not special.
